title: 第1044章 血昙三第1043章 血昙二
slug: 噬主成魔万魂幡饮血开锋
content_zh:
每个人的骨骼都被她选中了——二长老的肩胛骨，三长老的胸骨，四长老的脊椎骨，五长老的髋骨，六长老的膝盖骨，七长老的指骨，八长老的肋骨，九长老的头盖骨。
九只噬骨蛊虫同时钻入九个人的骨头里，地牢里响起了九种不同的啃噬声——沙沙声、吱吱声、咯吱声、咔嚓声——这些声音混合在一起，竟然形成了一种诡异的韵律，像一首由痛苦谱写的交响乐。
这就是“祭骨”的仪式。
九种噬骨蛊虫在九位长老的骨骼中啃噬出来的骨髓碎屑，会被噬骨蛊葫吸收，然后在葫芦内部炼化成一枚“九骨舍利”。
这枚舍利将作为九幽换魂大阵的最后一道祭品，用来激活同心魔偶的第三条能力——“同悲”。
同悲，是苏邀月为柳沉烟和孟晚棠准备的最终礼物。
当同心魔偶感受到两位宿主的情绪波动达到极限时，同悲能力会自动触发，将她们两人的感受同步放大并互相传递。
也就是说，柳沉烟感受到的每一分痛苦，孟晚棠都会同步感受到；孟晚棠感受到的每一分绝望，柳沉烟也会同步感受到。
她们会在同一具身体里，用不同的魂魄，承受完全相同的地狱。
九位长老的骨骼被啃噬了整整七个时辰。
七个时辰后，噬骨蛊葫的葫芦口吐出了一枚黄豆大的黑色舍利，舍利表面流动着九道颜色各异的纹路——那是九个人的骨髓精华被压缩到极限之后形成的骨纹。
苏邀月拈起那枚九骨舍利，将它放在引魂灯的灯芯上方。
舍利接触到灯火，瞬间熔化成九滴颜色各异的液体，顺着灯芯流入引魂灯，再通过引魂灯的导引注入孟晚棠的修罗魔核之中。
魔核剧烈地震动起来。
里面的两团光芒同时爆发，幽绿与墨黑交织缠绕，像一个溺水的人在水底拼命挣扎。
然后，第三道纹路在魔核表面浮现了——那是一道血红色的纹路，横贯整颗魔核，将幽绿和墨黑的光芒一分为二，又像一条血线将它们缝在了一起。
同悲，激活了。
苏邀月站在孟晚棠面前，仰头看着那颗魔核中新的纹路，满意地点了点头。
她伸出右手，五指张开，对准魔核的方向，开始念动咒诀。
这是九幽换魂大咒的第二段——“魂归”。

将柳沉烟的魂魄彻底融入修罗魔核，让她和孟晚棠的本能融合成同心魔偶的完整形态。
咒诀念到第三句的时候，地牢的石壁上忽然裂开了一道口子。
不是被外力砸开的，是石壁自己裂开的，像是被一道极细极锋利的剑气从内侧划开。
裂缝中涌出了大量的黑色魔液，魔液中裹着一团白色的东西。
那团白色的东西在魔液中翻滚了几下，然后缓缓展开——那是一袭白色的裙子。
裙摆拖曳三丈，每一寸布料都完好无损，甚至连褶皱都和三十年前一模一样。
苏邀月认出了那条裙子。
那是她三十年前在合欢宗炉鼎房里穿的那条白裙。
合欢宗的炉鼎都被要求穿白裙，因为白色显脏，脏了就能一眼看出来，客人就不会再点这个炉鼎的名，炉鼎就会被送去“回炉”——回炉不是重新修炼，是被丢进合欢宗后山的万蛊坑里当蛊虫的饲料。
她十九岁那年，就是穿着这条白裙被丢进了万蛊坑。
后来她从蛊坑里爬出来的时候，裙子已经被蛊虫咬得只剩下几根布条，她用树皮和藤蔓裹住身体，赤着脚走过了三千里路，走到了万毒门的地界。
她以为自己再也不会看到这条裙子了。
可此刻，它居然出现在这里。
从地牢石壁的裂缝中流出来的魔液里，完好无损地飘到了她的脚下。
苏邀月低头看着那条白裙，看了很久。
然后她弯腰把它捡起来，抖了抖上面并不存在的灰尘，将它叠得整整齐齐，放在了一旁的石台上。
“三十年没见，你还是这么白。”她对着裙子说，声音轻得像在跟一个老朋友叙旧，“可惜我已经不穿白色了。
白色不耐脏。”
她转身继续念咒。
但咒诀念到第六句的时候，地牢的石壁上又裂开了一道口子。

这一次，裂缝中涌出的不是魔液，而是一股极浓极浓的腥臭味——那是万蛊坑的味道。
三十年前她被丢进万蛊坑的时候，这股味道灌满了她的鼻腔、喉咙、肺叶，让她在坑底吐了三天三夜，吐到最后胃里只剩酸水，酸水吐完了就开始干呕，干呕到喉咙出血。
后来她不吐了，因为她开始吃蛊虫了。
content_en:
Everyone's bones were chosen by her - the shoulder blades of the second elder, the sternum of the third elder, the spine of the fourth elder, the hip bones of the fifth elder, the kneecaps of the sixth elder, the phalanges of the seventh elder, the ribs of the eighth elder, and the skull of the ninth elder.
Nine bone-eating Gu worms burrowed into the bones of nine people at the same time, and nine different gnawing sounds resounded in the dungeon—rustling, squeaking, creaking, and clicking—these sounds mixed together to form a strange rhythm, like a symphony composed of pain.
This is the ritual of "bone sacrifice".
The bone marrow fragments gnawed out by the nine kinds of bone-eating Gu insects from the bones of the nine elders will be absorbed by the Bone-eating Gu gourd, and then refined into a "nine-bone relic" inside the gourd.
This relic will be used as the last sacrifice in the Nine Nether Soul Exchange Formation, and will be used to activate the third ability of the Tongxin Demon - "Tongxin Sorrow".
Sharing sorrow is the final gift Su Yaoyue prepared for Liu Chenyan and Meng Wantang.
When the Tongxin Golem feels that the emotional fluctuations of the two hosts reach the limit, the Tongxin ability will be automatically triggered, amplifying their feelings simultaneously and transmitting them to each other.
In other words, every bit of pain that Liu Chenyan felt was felt by Meng Wantang at the same time; every bit of despair that Meng Wantang felt was felt by Liu Chenyan at the same time.
They will endure the exact same hell in the same body with different souls.
The bones of the nine elders were chewed away for a full seven hours.
Seven hours later, a black relic the size of a soybean was spit out from the mouth of the bone-eating Gu gourd. Nine lines of different colors flowed on the surface of the relic - they were the bone lines formed after the bone marrow essence of nine people was compressed to the limit.
Su Yaoyue picked up the nine-bone relic and placed it on top of the wick of the soul-inducing lamp.
When the relic came into contact with the light, it instantly melted into nine drops of liquid of different colors, flowed into the soul-inducing lamp along the wick, and was then injected into Meng Wantang's Shura Demonic Core through the guidance of the soul-inducing lamp.
The magic core shook violently.
Two groups of light inside burst out at the same time, green and black intertwined, like a drowning person struggling desperately under the water.
Then, the third line appeared on the surface of the magic core - it was a blood-red line that ran across the entire magic core, dividing the green and black light into two, and sewing them together like a blood line.
Shared sorrow, activated.
Su Yaoyue stood in front of Meng Wantang, looked up at the new lines in the magic core, and nodded with satisfaction.
She stretched out her right hand, spread her fingers, pointed it in the direction of the magic core, and began to recite the incantation.
This is the second paragraph of Jiuyou's soul-changing curse - "Soul Return".
Completely integrate Liu Chenyan's soul into the Shura Demonic Core, allowing her and Meng Wantang's instincts to merge into the complete form of a concentric demon.
When the third sentence of the curse was recited, a hole suddenly opened in the stone wall of the dungeon.
It was not smashed open by external force, but the stone wall cracked by itself, as if it was cut open from the inside by a very thin and sharp sword energy.
A large amount of black magic fluid poured out from the cracks, and there was a ball of white stuff wrapped in the magic fluid.
The white thing tumbled a few times in the magic liquid, and then slowly unfolded - it was a white dress.
The hem of the skirt trailed three feet, and every inch of fabric was intact. Even the folds were exactly the same as they were thirty years ago.
Su Yaoyue recognized the skirt.
That was the white dress she wore in the furnace room of the Hehuan Sect thirty years ago.
Hehuan Sect's furnace cauldrons are all required to wear white skirts, because white looks dirty, and if it is dirty, it can be seen at a glance. Guests will no longer call the furnace cauldron's name, and the furnace cauldron will be sent to "return to the furnace" - being returned to the furnace does not mean re-training, but being thrown into the poison pit in the back mountain of the Hehuan Sect to be used as feed for voodoo insects.
When she was nineteen years old, she was thrown into the pit of poison while wearing this white dress.
Later, when she crawled out of the poison pit, her skirt had been bitten by the poison insects and only a few strips of cloth were left. She wrapped herself with bark and vines.He walked barefoot for three thousand miles and arrived at the boundary of Wandu Gate.
She thought she would never see the dress again.
But at this moment, it actually appears here.
The demon fluid flowing out from the cracks in the dungeon stone wall floated to her feet intact.
Su Yaoyue looked down at the white skirt for a long time.
Then she bent down to pick it up, shook off the non-existent dust on it, folded it neatly, and placed it on the stone platform aside.
"I haven't seen you for thirty years, and you're still so white." She said to the skirt, her voice as soft as if she was reminiscing with an old friend, "It's a pity that I don't wear white anymore.
White is not resistant to stains. "
She turned around and continued chanting.
But when the sixth sentence of the curse was recited, another hole opened in the stone wall of the dungeon.
This time, what came out of the crack was not magic liquid, but an extremely strong fishy smell - that was the smell of the Ten Thousand Gu Pit.
When she was thrown into the Ten Thousand Gu Pit thirty years ago, this smell filled her nose, throat, and lungs, causing her to vomit at the bottom of the pit for three days and three nights. In the end, only acid water was left in her stomach. After vomiting the acid water, she started to retching until her throat bled.
Later, she stopped vomiting because she started eating worms.
